what_this_is: the 43 hosts the live pass over samples/repo86 handed to loadExtractor with no registry entry, each probed from this machine today. every evidence line names a request that was actually made. where a host refuses, the refusal was reproduced with three independent tls stacks: curl 8.16 on schannel, openssl 3.0 through python requests and through s_client, and the live gate's own jvm client as recorded in out/runA and out/runB.

states.alive: reachable, and the response is the real thing even where the last mile is hard work
states.alive_no_media: the site answers but no request returned media or a media url, so it is not claimable
states.refusing: reachable and refuses: a tls alert, an untrusted certificate, or a cloudflare interactive challenge
states.not_a_host: answers, but what it serves is an advertising gate rather than media
states.origin_down: the edge answers 522, the origin does not answer
states.gone: no address record, or nothing listening

cf-challenge-shortener.mechanism: the indian drive shortener chain, behind a cloudflare interactive challenge or an advertising gate. refusing rather than gone

gone-or-parked.mechanism: no address record, nothing listening, or a domain for sale

hubcloud-drive.mechanism: a drive page whose download anchor points at gamerxyt.com/hubcloud.php with an id and a base64 token, which then names pixeldrain and a 10Gbps mirror. verified end to end on hubcloud.one

jwt-gate-shell.mechanism: a 484 to 493 byte Loading document that replaces location with the same url plus ?ch=1&js=<jwt>&sid=<uuid>. one operator, four domains, and a per address 429 throttle across the 192.157.56.x block

known-family-domain.mechanism: a new domain of a mechanism the layer already implements. verified by finding the family's own fingerprint in the response: MDCore, pass_md5, the byse shell, the packed vidmoly sources, the lulustream expiry template

mirror-wrapper.mechanism: the page is not a host. it names or fetches the real embed, and the right move is to hand that url back to loadExtractor. verified on animeworld.site, animedekho.app and pinoystreaming.qzz.io

origin-down.mechanism: the cloudflare edge answers with a valid certificate and returns 522 because the origin behind it does not answer

plain-source-player.mechanism: the media url is in the delivered document in the clear, with no crypto and no second call

sealed-config-player.mechanism: alive and serving, with the source sealed: in page AES with the key present, an encrypted blob with no key, a 245KB obfuscated builder, a request signature, or end to end encryption

tls-refuser.mechanism: refuses the tls handshake itself, with access_denied or a terminated handshake or an untrusted certificate, identically to three independent clients

groups.group: G3 the hubcloud chain and the two plain players

abyssplayer.com.note: the media field is an encrypted blob the player bundle decodes, and no key material is in the page. an extractor means reversing core.bundle.js

as-cdn26.top.evidence: root and the extension's own /video/<id> both 522 from the cloudflare edge with a 7225B error page, on two probes two hours apart. tls completes and the certificate is valid, the origin does not answer

bestx.stream.evidence: tls alert access_denied, alert 49, from three clients: curl on schannel with SEC_E_LOGON_DENIED, openssl 3.0 through requests and through s_client, and the live gate's own jvm client which logged SSLHandshakeException: (access_denied)

boosterx.stream.evidence: tls alert access_denied from the same three clients. shares 172.236.108.16 and 172.239.193.153 with bestx.stream

en.thenaukriadda.in.note: an advertising gate rather than a media host, which is what BuiltinExtractors already records. no extractor should claim it

filebee.xyz.evidence: root and /embed/<id> both return the same 1457B react shell. /api/file/<id>, /api/files/<id>, /api/file/embed/<id> and /api/video/<id> all return that same shell, so whatever route answers is not on this origin. the 1563430B bundle names doodstream, streamTape, streamWish and googlefileId as its file types

filesforever.link.evidence: GET /embed/bawvzji 200 23986B carries input gdmrfid=bawvzji and input view_token=<64 hex> and POSTs both to /embeds/track_view.php. that endpoint answers json and checked our post, 400 with error file_slug required, so it is live and parameter validated
filesforever.link.note: the response carrying the embed url was not obtained: the endpoint wants a field spelling we have not matched yet. it shares animeworld.site's storage key, so the same option list is likely behind it

flixcloud.cc.evidence: GET /e/u6pohmficyxu 200 18429B titled [Judas]_One-Punch_Man_-_S01E01_encoded.mkv. an artplayer page whose config carries kf_<hex> as a base64 key, ivf_<hex> as a base64 iv and metadata encoding aes256cbc, with subtitles and fonts on vault92.slopnet.site in the clear
flixcloud.cc.note: key and iv are in the page, so this is decryptable. the field names are randomized per load, so an extractor has to find them by shape and never by name

gdflix.dev.evidence: root 403 and /file/<id> 403, 5746B titled Just a moment, on three different ids
gdflix.dev.note: a cloudflare interactive challenge. no pass so far has had a challenge host attached, so this is refusing rather than gone

mega.nz.evidence: GET /embed/<handle>#<key> 200 1598B, the mega web app shell that boots /secureboot.js. three different embed handles returned the identical shell
mega.nz.note: the file is encrypted end to end: the key is in the fragment and the bytes need AES-CTR decryption as they stream. that is a decrypting local proxy, not an extractor, and there is no plain url to hand a player

mfw09.org.evidence: root 403, but GET /e/u48xqtv5b3t5 200 1972B titled Byse Frontend, the same one script and empty root div shell as the ten byse domains the layer already reads. three different ids all answered

miiixdrop.net.evidence: GET /e/pmxmpe 200 78372B carrying MDCore.ref set to pmxmpe, MDCore.sublangs, and the packed eval(function(p,a,c,k,e,d) whose payload assigns MDCore.wurl to a delivery38-2 host path

new6.gdtot.dad.evidence: tls alert access_denied from the same three clients on three different embed ids. 103.224.182.250

pinoystreaming.qzz.io.evidence: GET /embed/movie?imdb=tt37971717 200 54481B whose script fetches /vs_src.php?type=movie&id=tt37971717. that endpoint answered 200 application/json 179B with src set to https://cloudorchestranova.com/embed/movie/tt37971717?vs=<token>

raretoonsindia.co.evidence: no address record at all: getaddrinfo 11001 from python, curl error 6 could not resolve, openssl BIO_lookup_ex No such host is known

sbbrisk.com.evidence: the first GET of /zb7f11qmar45.html answered 200 490B, the Loading shell replacing location with the same url plus ?ch=1&js=<jwt>&sid=<uuid>. following that gate returned 3084B whose head is a meta refresh to berht-shv.com/zokredirect. later requests answered 429 17B

streamango.com.evidence: dns resolves to 34.235.250.63, nothing accepts a connection on 443 within 21 seconds, three clients

strmup.to.evidence: the live gate's jvm client fetched /G4jXb792UY8QV and got 200 text/html 484B, the Loading shell. every request from this address today answered 429 17B Too many requests

tryembed.us.cc.source: out/live-w1-unpack.log, where StreamPlay-Anime fetched it 200 text/html 17890B after kyren.moe/api/stream/5040/1?server=tryembed named it

upstream.to.evidence: tls alert access_denied from curl on schannel, from openssl and from the jvm client, on two embed ids. 185.178.208.135

vidmoly.net.evidence: GET /embed-3uc7masntzp0.html 200 42575B titled Naruto S00E01 German Subbed 416p WebRip x264-NTFS, carrying the packed eval and, once unpacked, sources with file set to a prx-1590-for.vmnow.online hls2 master.m3u8 with t, s and e query parameters. a second id answered the same way
